questions.question: A line of poetry is most often a single what?
choices: row of words in a poem

questions.question: A stanza is a grouped unit of lines, often separated by what?
Rhyme is the repetition of similar what?
Meter refers to a pattern of what in a poem?
The speaker of a poem is best understood as what?
choices: always the poet as a private person
the voice speaking in the poem

questions.question: “Bright birds beat their wings” repeats the initial b sound. What device is this?
A sentence continues across a line break without a pause or punctuation. What is this called?
A line ends with punctuation that creates a pause before the next line. What structure is used?
A phrase repeats at the end of each stanza. What is this repeated line or phrase called?
Two consecutive lines rhyme and form a pair. What is this unit called?
A poem has no regular rhyme or meter but still uses deliberate line breaks. What form may it use?
A pause occurs in the middle of a poetic line. What is that pause called?
“Time is a thief” compares time to a thief without “like” or “as.” What device is used?
A poem repeats “I will return” at the start of several lines. What does the repetition most directly create?
The speaker describes a small seed pushing through concrete. What idea could this image support?
A poem uses short, abrupt lines during a moment of panic. What can the line breaks contribute?
A speaker praises a storm while the imagery describes damage and loss. What should a reader examine?
choices: whether the tone is ironic or complex
whether the poem has a narrator

questions.question: A poem’s speaker says “we,” but never identifies the group. What should readers do?
choices: decide it is the poet’s family
use the poem’s details to infer who “we” includes

questions.question: A repeated image of a fading candle accompanies the speaker’s memories. Which interpretation is best supported if the poem also emphasizes time passing?
choices: the candle may connect to change or limited time
the candle must be a literal character
it proves the poem is a drama
it has no meaning beyond its color

questions.question: A student says a poem’s theme is “the ocean.” What revision is stronger?
choices: The ocean can represent both danger and renewal in the speaker’s life.
